about_the_game:
This purchase includes the complete Original Soundtrack (OST) and the OST exclusive Original Vocal Soundtrack (OVST) Hyperdream Edition for a total of 28 tracks!

Disc 1:

Hentai Senpai: Spacegirls 92 Original Soundtrack, composed by Kink Master Studios.
This soundtrack contains 8 tracks, provided in both mp3 and wav format.

Disc 2 (OST exclusive):

Hentai Senpai: Spacegirls 92 Original Vocal Soundtrack Hyperdream Edition, remixed by Kink Master Studios. This soundtrack contains 20 tracks, provided in both mp3 and wav format.

Songs with "(Explicit)" in the title have lyrics and vocals, all other songs are instrumentals.

To access the high quality wav files, go to Steam Settings > Music > Download high quality audio files.
